verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de says businesses can "automate notarization workflows" through its API and webhooks, so asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has nothing on versioning, review, change history, or rollback of automations or webhook configurations. The documented endpoints only create and retrieve notarization, incorporation, translation, and registration requests.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
